#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

APP_DIR="${1:-$HOME/apps/example}"
LOG_FILE="${APP_DIR}/server.log"

if [[ ! -d "$APP_DIR" ]]; then
  echo "Error: directory $APP_DIR does not exist" >&2
  exit 1
fi

cd "$APP_DIR"
nohup ./server --config config.yaml >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1 &
echo "Server started with PID $!"
